title: Implement admin-only access control for content management

requirements.text: Implement backend admin authorization system that registers the owner's Principal ID as the sole admin and validates admin status for all create, update, and delete operations on poems and collections

quotes: mai is app ka pwner hu mere siva kissi ko bhi is app par na toh koi cheez upload karna allow hai na hi koi cheez edit na hi koi collection edit

acceptanceCriteria: Owner's Principal ID is registered as admin in backend state
All poem create/update/delete operations verify caller is admin
All collection create/update/delete operations verify caller is admin
Non-admin users receive authorization error when attempting admin operations

requirements.text: Add frontend route guards to all /admin/* routes (including /admin/add-poem, /admin/collections, and admin panel) that check if the authenticated user is admin and redirect non-admin users to the home page with an informative message

quotes: dusre account se mai upload kar pa raha hu
Jab koi non-admin user admin route access karne ki koshish karega, use home page pe redirect kar diya jayega

acceptanceCriteria: Route guard checks admin status before allowing access to /admin/add-poem
Route guard checks admin status before allowing access to /admin/collections
Route guard checks admin status before allowing access to admin panel
Non-admin users are redirected to home page when attempting to access admin routes
User sees a toast notification explaining they lack admin permissions

requirements.text: Hide or disable admin navigation links (Add Poem, Collections, Admin Panel) in the header Layout component for non-admin users so only the owner sees these navigation options

quotes: Sirf aap hi poems upload, edit, delete kar sakte hain
Sirf aap hi collections create, edit, manage kar sakte hain

acceptanceCriteria: Add Poem link is hidden for non-admin users
Collections management link is hidden for non-admin users
Admin Panel link is hidden for non-admin users
Navigation links are visible and functional for admin user
Home link remains visible to all users

requirements.text: Ensure public users retain full access to view poems, download poems, like poems, and comment on poems without any restrictions

quotes: public sirf dekh sake download kar sake aur like comment kar sake bas yahi chahiye

acceptanceCriteria: Non-admin users can view all poems on home page
Non-admin users can view individual poem details
Non-admin users can download poems as images
Non-admin users can like poems
Non-admin users can comment on poems
Backend allows these read and interaction operations for all authenticated users

constraints: Do not modify the single-actor architecture in backend/main.mo
Do not edit immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity hooks, useActor.ts, main.tsx, or components/ui
Admin authorization must use Principal ID comparison, not usernames or other identifiers
Preserve all existing poem viewing, downloading, liking, and commenting functionality for public users
nonGoals: Multi-admin support or role-based access control beyond single owner
Admin user interface for managing multiple administrators
Permission levels or granular access control
Public user registration or profile creation restrictions
